status.nb: 6 væpnede hendelser meldt de siste sju dagene, 20 prosent flere enn uken før, flest i Port-Au-Prince, Gros-Morne og Kenscoff.

summary.en: Security forces in Port-au-Prince and Kenscoff are now confronting gangs with support from a Kenya-led multinational mission, while Erik Prince has deployed Blackwater contractors using drones, air support and over 2,000 drone strikes against the gangs. The United Nations renewed sanctions on Haiti and added US$75 million for life-saving aid to 507,000 people. Bangladesh has begun pre-deploying a vanguard of soldiers, with an advance team leaving for the UN security mission in Haiti. Child gang recruits report being forced to kill under gang pressure. The conflict caused 193 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.
summary.nb: Sikkerhetsstyrker i Port-au-Prince og Kenscoff konfronterer nå gjenger med støtte fra et Kenya-ledet multinasjonalt oppdrag, mens Erik Prince har satt inn Blackwater-entreprenører som bruker droner, luftstøtte og over 2 000 droneangrep mot gjengene. FN fornyet sanksjonene mot Haiti og la til 75 millioner dollar til livreddende hjelp til 507 000 personer. Bangladesh har begynt å forutplassere en forløpsstyrke av soldater, med et forløpsteam som reiser til FN-sikkerhetsoppdraget i Haiti. Barn som er rekruttert av gjenger rapporterer at de blir tvunget til å drepe under gjengpress. Konflikten forårsaket 193 dødsfall i kamper i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

background.title: Haitian conflict
background.extract: Since 2020, Haiti's capital Port-au-Prince has been the site of an ongoing armed conflict between rival gangs and the state. The government of Haiti and national security forces have struggled to maintain their control of Port-au-Prince amid this conflict, with gangs speculated to control up to 90% of the city by 2023. In response to the escalating fighting, an armed vigilante movement, known as bwa kale, also emerged, with the purpose of fighting the gangs. On 2 October 2023, United Nations Security Council Resolution 2699 was approved, authorizing a Kenya-led "multinational security support mission" to Haiti. Until 2024, the war was between two major groups and their allies: the Revolutionary Forces of the G9 Family and Allies and the G-Pèp. However, in February 2024 the two rival groups united in a coalition known as Viv Ansanm, formed to oppose the government and the UN mission.
